highlights.description: PDLC (Product Development Lifecycle) added as the canonical stage-ID hub: a native six-stage lifecycle splitting each AIDLC phase into parallel product/builder lenses, with a crosswalk other frameworks map their stages onto

added.description: `PDLCFramework` type and component types (`PDLCPhase`, `PDLCSubStage`, `PDLCDeliverable`, `PDLCGate`, `PDLCDependencies`/`PDLCDependency`, `PDLCTooling`) modeling the six-stage Product Development Lifecycle
Generic `FrameworkRelation`/`StageCrosswalk` types so any two cataloged frameworks can crosswalk through a shared stage-mapping shape instead of a bespoke pairwise mapping type

`frameworks/pdlc/pdlc-framework.json`: six-stage catalog entry with phases (role, `aiDlcPhase`, deliverables, gates, `parallelWith`), Product Definition's seven detailed sub-stages, a dependency graph closing the loop back to `product-definition`, and an AIDLC crosswalk via `relatedFrameworks`
`PDLC()`, `MustPDLC()`, `PDLCJSON()` accessor functions mirroring the existing `AIDLC()`/`MustAIDLC()` pattern

tests.description: `TestPDLC`: 6 phases in canonical order, 2 product/4 builder role split, Product Definition's 7 sub-stages, Builder/Product Operations run in parallel (not sequentially), AIDLC crosswalk symmetry (every AIDLC phase claimed by exactly 2 PDLC stages), dependency graph closes the loop

documentation.description: Root README catalog table row and Go usage example for PDLC; `frameworks/pdlc/README.md` documents the six-stage model and function reference
New `docs/frameworks/pdlc/index.md` MkDocs page covering the six PDLC stages, AIDLC/ASPM relationships, and Go usage; wired into `mkdocs.yml` nav
PDLC added to the Frameworks Overview table, relationship diagram, comparison matrix, and version/status table
`PDLC()`/`MustPDLC()`/`PDLCJSON()` and the generic `FrameworkRelation`/`StageCrosswalk` types documented in the Go Module API reference

highlights.description: AIDLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) added as the first Development Lifecycle framework, plus a full MkDocs documentation site

added.description: AIDLC framework: 3 phases (Inception, Construction, Operations), 12 document deliverables with evaluation criteria, human review gates between phases, LLM cost estimates (~$1.81 per full workflow), dependency graph for document generation order
AIDLC PIDL process specification (`aidlc-workflow.pidl.json`) with input/output data ports, latency budgets (P50/P95/P99), failure modes, and retry strategies
`AIDLC()`, `MustAIDLC()`, `AIDLCJSON()` accessor functions and full AIDLC type definitions

documentation.description: MkDocs documentation site with Material theme: homepage, getting started guides, framework docs (AIDLC, ASDM, AI-DORA, AI-SPACE, PBMM), Go API reference, PRISM/VisionSpec/PIDL integration guides, contributing guide

highlights.description: Initial framework catalog release: two original maturity models (ASDM, PBMM) and two AI-adapted metrics frameworks (AI-DORA, AI-SPACE), with a Go module providing typed embedded access

added.description: ASDM (Autonomous Software Delivery Model) framework spec: 7-level progression from Agile/Scrum to autonomous operations, with AWS Project Mantle (L5) and StrongDM Software Factory (L6) case studies
PBMM (Product Builder Maturity Model) framework spec: 7-level dual-path model (PM path, Engineer path) converging at L5-L6, with framework mappings to AI-DORA and AI-SPACE
AI-DORA framework spec: 4 metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, Change Failure Rate, MTTR) with AI-recalibrated elite/high/medium/low thresholds
AI-SPACE framework spec: 25 metrics across 5 dimensions (Satisfaction, Performance, Activity, Communication, Efficiency)
Go module with embedded framework access: `AIDora()`, `AISpace()`, `ASDM()`, `PBMM()` typed accessors, `Must*` variants, `*JSON()` raw-bytes access, `FS()` embedded filesystem

tests.description: Framework embedding tests verifying all four frameworks parse correctly, plus `Must*` functions, raw JSON access, and embedded FS

documentation.description: README with framework overview, case studies, Go module installation/usage examples, function reference table, PRISM integration patterns

internal.description: Shared GitHub Actions CI/lint/CodeQL workflows and golangci-lint configuration
